name: severity:critical
description: Blocks a core function, loses or exposes data, or breaks security

name: severity:major
description: A requirement is violated with a significant effect

name: severity:minor
description: A requirement is violated with a small effect

name: severity:enhancement
description: No requirement violated, but a concrete change would clearly improve an existing function

name: integration
description: Portal and Engine, or Portal and external services

name: tests
description: Defect in the shipped test suite

name: invalid
description: Not reproducible, or no requirement violated and not an enhancement
